reviews.title: totally worth it, the mic is awesome
reviews.comment: the noise canceling mic is amazing, my dog can be barking behind me and the people on the call have no idea, which is exactly what i was looking for. the sound is great as well, and i think the quality overall is great for the price. definitely recommend
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great headset, but check your sound settings
reviews.comment: Great sound quality and mic at a decent price point. Seems sturdy and looks professional. Its comfortable too but I’m not wearing them all day. The only issue I’ve had is sometimes during Teams meetings peoples voices will sound very distorted and it’s like a static noise. That could be on my end since I had noise suppression turned on in Teams and it might have been interfering. So I’ll see if that fixes the issue. My return window just closed a few days ago so I hope it works out.
reviews.author: Elizabeth G.

reviews.title: WOW!!!!
reviews.comment: My 2 year old & and my 5 month old baby can be crying, at the same time , right beside me and my customers will not hear a single thing. They think I’m in a silent office. That’s how well the noise cancelling works! The first day I got this headset I turned my tv to 60 with music blairing , called my dad to test it out … he could hear me perfectly & couldn’t hear my music one bit! It’s SPOOKY how good these work!
reviews.author: Ileana Gonzalez

reviews.title: So good at blocking out dogs barking
reviews.comment: I work from home and have two dogs who occasionally bark and always at the worst time. I watched a video on YouTube where the reviewer let the audience hear the difference between headsets in an open office environment and this one was a clear winner for the price. It works great. My supervisor helped me test it and could not hear any barking even when it was happening close to me. This headset is also more comfortable than any other over the ear headsets I’ve used before. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Alison Lewis

reviews.title: Get these!
reviews.comment: I work remote from home and tested several headsets. This one had the best noise-cancelling mic.
reviews.author: Monica Faldon
